entries.reason: a class of the port's own under a name no SDK header declares, compiled with hidden visibility so the band exports nothing under it, defined at packages/a/apple-backports/Metal/MTLSharedEvent12.m. It is not an SDK api and the ledger is an SDK ledger, so nothing is claimed about SDK behaviour with it
entries.effect: nothing is claimed: the ledger records no behaviour for CharonMetalEventState, because it is port machinery and not API. The class is defined in Metal/MTLSharedEvent12.m and the band's export list does not and should not contain it
entries.source: SDK 16.4, Metal, the header of MTLSharedEvent, whose API arrived in 12.0
